text:
Sam (AE): Quick heads-up — NEXUS POC readout tomorrow 11:00am PT. Need final metrics, QSA answers, and the pricing ask to present. Can folks drop final items here by EOD? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Ashok (Solutions): Copy. I have the eval suite results ready. Will paste summary shortly.

Maria (SE): pushed a short results table to the drive: https://redwood.internal/drive/nexus-poc/results - TL;DR: latency stable, but hallucination rate ~6% on edge cases.

Ashok (Solutions): Summary metrics from our runs:
- 95th latency: 320ms
- Throughput: 45 req/s (batch=4)
- Embedding cost delta vs baseline: -18%
- Task accuracy vs baseline model: +3.2%
- Hallucination (customer eval set): 6.1% 

Ashok (Solutions): Eval prompt snippet we used:```
PROMPT: Extract canonical entities and normalized address from noisy customer paragraph.
METRICS: exact_match, partial_match, F1.
```

Jake (Nexus Inc): Thanks — can you confirm what "hallucination" means in that metric? For us, any invented company names are blockers.

Maria (SE): @Jake good call. Hallucination here = generated tokens not grounded in the prompt or verifier DB. We ran an additional filter that flagged invented org names. Most failures were edge cases with truncated addresses.

Sam (AE): Jake, what's your success bar for the readout? Is <5% hallucination acceptable, or do you need 0% for go/no-go?

Jake (Nexus Inc): For MVP customer-facing features we need <=2% on our core prompt set. For internal tooling, 5% ok. So we need to highlight which prompts are customer-facing.

Rachel (Legal): Quick legal/infosec note: Nexus still needs answers to two QSA items we promised — data retention policy for cached KV, and confirmation of at-rest encryption + KMS usage. Also DPA signature before production. I attached the stub in the drive.

Ashok (Solutions): On retention: runtime KV cache TTL is configurable per-deployment — we set it to 24h for this POC by default. We can set to 0 (no KV cache persisted) for Nexus if they want. At-rest encryption: yes, AES-256, customer-managed keys via KMS is supported for Private and Dedicated; hosted uses our KMS (we can do key-rotation logs).

Rachel (Legal): Great — please add that exact phrasing to the QSA doc: "KV cache TTL configurable; option to disable; AES-256 at-rest; KMS-supported (customer-managed in Private/Dedicated)." I'll give final sign-off after that.

Sam (AE): Pricing ask: Jake — are you expecting a committed capacity quote or pay-as-you-go?

Jake (Nexus Inc): We want committed for predictable costs. What's the minimum term/commit?

Sam (AE): Options to present tomorrow:
1) 6-month committed pool (reserved GPUs) — 20% discount vs on-demand.
2) 12-month committed pool — 30% discount + priority routing SLA.
3) Pilot pay-as-you-go (no commitment) — standard rates, no SLA.
Pick one for the readout and we can include a ballpark monthly.

Jake (Nexus Inc): Start with 6-month committed. Need numbers though.

Sam (AE): I'll include a ballpark $35k/mo for the 6-month reserved profile (subject to final infra sizing).

Maria (SE): For the readout slides I propose:
- Slide 1: POC summary (scope, timeline)
- Slide 2: Key metrics table (latency, throughput, accuracy, hallucination)
- Slide 3: Fail cases (3 examples with root cause)
- Slide 4: Security & compliance answers (KV TTL, KMS, SOC2 status)
- Slide 5: Pricing & next steps (commit options, DPA sign-off)

Ashok (Solutions): I can take Slide 3 and add remediation suggestions: prompt constraints, post-verifier, and optional hybrid retrieval step.

DevOps Bot: POC resource snapshot:
```
instances: 4 g4dn.xlarge
gpu_util: 62% avg
disk_io: 120MB/s
kv_cache_size: 1.2GB
uptime: 7 days
```

Rachel (Legal): One more blocker: Nexus asked for pen-test report. We have a recent one (Aug 2025) but need permission to share redacted version. I'll request it from security.

Sam (AE): Action items before 11am readout: 
- Maria: final slide deck (by 6pm PT)
- Ashok: include remediation + per-prompt breakdown (by 5pm PT)
- Rachel: confirm QSA wording + pen-test share status (by EOD)
- DevOps: post final resource/metrics dump (automated)
- Jake: confirm 6-month commit interest (agree to ballpark $35k/mo)

Jake (Nexus Inc): Confirmed — we are comfortable with the 6-month pilot at ballpark pending the readout. I'll escalate DPA internally.

Sam (AE): Thanks all — i'll assemble deck and send final readout invite. See you tomorrow. :rocket:
